title: GyS AVI — Document Chatbot
description: Conversational assistant over corporate documents using the RAG pattern: hybrid search, semantic re-ranking and answers with citations traceable to the source document.
problem: Teams were losing hours searching for information scattered across institutional documentation. The solution lets them ask in natural language and get the answer with a citation linked to the supporting document, removing manual search without sacrificing traceability.

architecture.caption: Five layers: access, application, retrieval and generation, ingestion and data, plus a cross-cutting band for security and observability.

flow: The user signs in to the access portal, which validates credentials against Cosmos DB and issues its own JWT.
From the portal the chat application opens on App Service, which builds the retrieval pipeline and keeps the conversation thread.
The backend embeds the question with Azure OpenAI and runs a hybrid search (vector + keyword) on Azure AI Search.
The semantic ranker re-orders the passages and returns the most relevant chunks together with their source document.
Azure OpenAI writes the answer using only those passages as context and returns citations linked to the document in Blob Storage.
Ingestion runs separately: Document Intelligence extracts text, tables and structure, and the result is chunked, embedded and indexed.

components.name: Azure App Service
components.role: RAG orchestration backend and web frontend.

components.name: Azure AI Search
components.role: Vector and hybrid index with semantic re-ranking.

components.name: Document Intelligence
components.role: Layout, table and text extraction at ingestion.

insight.title: Architecture decision
insight.text: Access control comes from a custom portal with JWT on Cosmos DB, instead of the identity-based filtering of the base accelerator. For production with sensitive information, enabling Entra ID and per-document filtering in the search query would be the next step.
